correctness.rationale: For each i>=2, leaf survival is the product over future parent choices and has probability (i-1)/(n-1). For j>i, conditioning on A_j=1 removes exactly the j-to-i destruction hazard, giving Cov(A_j,Y_i)=(i-1)/[(n-1)(j-1)(j-2)]. Summing this exact kernel gives both the linear leaf-label profile and the equal-share root-attachment profile. Independent Bernoulli root attachments and the exact leaf recursion supply the variances used in the correlation.

value.rationale: Root degree and total leaves are canonical local and global statistics of the standard random recursive tree. The exact limiting covariance together with vanishing correlation quantifies scale separation, while the equal-share identity reveals a simple growth-time mechanism that is invisible from the two marginal laws.
